title: Calculate charge balance — charge_balance
text: Potential changes workflows years made difficult ascertain exactly charge balances calculated older samples. resulted discrepancies EMS locally calculated charge balances. Therefore consistency, calculate charge balances samples using ALS formula . One difference calculation ALS, use significant digits calculating MEQ. anion sum = chloride_dissolved_meq/l + sulfate_dissolved_meq/l + fluoride_dissolved_meq/l + nitrate_no3_dissolved_meq/l + nitrogen_nitrite_dissolved_no2_meq/l + alkalinity_total_4.5_as_caco3_meq/l cation sum = calcium_dissolved_meq/l + magnesium_dissolved_meq/l + sodium_dissolved_meq/l + potassium_dissolved_meq/l + aluminum_dissolved_meq/l + copper_dissolved_meq/l + iron_dissolved_meq/l + manganese_dissolved_meq/l + zinc_dissolved_meq/l + nitrogen_ammonia_dissolved_meq/l + (10 ^ (-ph)) * 1000 Charge balance = 100 x (Cation Sum - Anion sum) / (Cation Sum + Anion Sum) Missing values ignored (ie. generally treated 0). However, values cations anions missing charge balance NA. multiple measures observation (.e. repeated measures), use mean MEQ value parameter.

text: Water type based anions Cl, SO4, HCO3 cations Ca, Mg, Na K. Ions ranked proportion MEQ, greater 10% listed descending order presence, cations first.
